defects.description: Two incompatible soft-delete conventions coexist in the same codebase: orders uses deleted_at TIMESTAMP, users uses is_deleted BOOLEAN, with no shared abstraction reconciling them.

The shared excludeDeleted() helper hardcodes the orders-style convention (deleted_at) and is applied uniformly to both tables; combined with the ORM's silent-skip mode for unknown columns, the filter is silently dropped for `users` (which has no deleted_at column) instead of erroring, so deleted users pass through the filter unfiltered.

Nothing in the codebase documents "excluded from all queries when deleted, regardless of representation" as a system-wide invariant -- that missing invariant is the root cause the other two symptoms trace back to.
